instruction:
Use Abaqus/CAE through the graphical user interface to perform a constrained thermal stress analysis (Case A). Use the N-mm-MPa unit system.

Model Definition:
Create a 3D Deformable Solid part using Extrusion. Sketch a 10 mm x 10 mm rectangle in the Y-Z plane (Y from 0 to 10, Z from 0 to 10) and extrude along the global X-axis to a length of 100 mm.

Material and Section:
Define a material named Steel with Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa, Poisson's ratio nu = 0.3, and thermal expansion coefficient = 1.2e-5 /K. Create a Solid Homogeneous section using Steel and assign it to the entire bar.

Assembly:
Create one dependent instance of the bar.

Analysis Step:
Create a Static, General step named Step-Thermal-A.

Loads and Boundary Conditions:
Apply a predefined temperature field of 20 degC to the whole model in the Initial step. Constrain both end faces with U1 = U2 = U3 = 0: the left end face at X = 0 and the right end face at X = 100 mm. In Step-Thermal-A, apply a predefined temperature field of 120 degC to the whole model.

Discretization:
Mesh the bar with a global seed size of 5 mm. Assign the element type C3D8R and generate the mesh.

Job Execution:
Create a job named Job-ThermalStress-A, submit it for analysis, and wait for the analysis to complete successfully.

Deliverables:
Save the model database as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-ThermalStress-A.cae and ensure the output database is written to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-ThermalStress-A.odb.
